clauses.text: 1. Purpose and Background

source_location.excerpt: 1. Purpose and Background

clauses.text: 1.1 This Statement of Work (“SOW”) is entered into pursuant to the Master Services Agreement (“MSA”) executed between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 with its registered office at [Address], (“Vendor”) and FinSecure Services, a financial services provider engaged in banking, insurance, and fintech operations with its principal office at [Address], (“Client”).

source_location.excerpt: 1.1 This Statement of Work (“SOW”) is entered into pursuant to the Master Services Agreement (“MSA”) executed between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 with its registered office at [Address], (“Vendor”) and FinSecure Services, a financial services provider engaged in banking, insurance, and fintech operations with its principal office at [Address], (“Client”).

clauses.text: 1.2 The purpose of this SOW is to define the scope, responsibilities, deliverables, timelines, pricing, acceptance criteria, and risk mitigation measures associated with the design, manufacture, supply, installation, commissioning, and post-installation maintenance of IoT-enabled smart power management modules for Client’s branch offices nationwide.

source_location.excerpt: 1.2 The purpose of this SOW is to define the scope, responsibilities, deliverables, timelines, pricing, acceptance criteria, and risk mitigation measures associated with the design, manufacture, supply, installation, commissioning, and post-installation maintenance of IoT-enabled smart power management modules for Client’s branch offices nationwide.

clauses.text: 1.3 This SOW is supplemental to, and governed by, the terms of the MSA, except as expressly modified herein. All capitalized terms not defined in this SOW shall have the meanings assigned in the MSA.

source_location.excerpt: 1.3 This SOW is supplemental to, and governed by, the terms of the MSA, except as expressly modified herein. All capitalized terms not defined in this SOW shall have the meanings assigned in the MSA.

clauses.text: “Installation Services” means all activities required to install, configure, and integrate the Hardware Units at the Client’s branch offices.
